objective: If the mapped row-normalized scale gate passes, fit every missing tensor in the exact Qwen3.8-27B llama.cpp text graph and measure honest complete-text-graph reconstruction and storage

scope.selection: model.language_model.* plus lm_head.weight; exactly matches llama.cpp --no-nextn model_n_params

supplemental_fit.selection: every rank-2-or-higher text-graph tensor absent from the authenticated 402-tensor parent
supplemental_fit.source: pinned safetensors rows quantized with optimal group-128 ternary scales
supplemental_fit.algorithm: one FP16 row geometric-mean anchor plus one per-tensor 16-entry FP16 log-ratio codebook
supplemental_fit.final_assignment: minimum absolute error against frozen FP16 anchor times FP16 ratio

promotion_rules: all 546 rank-2+ text tensors and all 210595840 group scales must be covered
the parameter denominator must equal llama.cpp model_n_params 26895998464
vision and MTP/NextN weights may be omitted only because both candidate and controls omit those graphs
all reconstruction thresholds and the complete-text-bundle storage threshold must pass
a pass authorizes text-representation export and direct decoder work only
CUTE, MATH, code, MMLU-type, WikiText, and paired CPU throughput remain mandatory after export
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
this gate cannot prove model capability or a scientific breakthrough
claim_boundary: Complete deployable Qwen3.8-27B text graph only; multimodal vision and MTP/NextN graphs are explicitly out of scope for both candidate and controls.
